title: Kevin Feige says Secret Wars will launch Marvel's new era in 2028
excerpt:
Marvel's next Avengers film will help establish a new era.
Feige points to 2028 as a significant milestone.
body_md:
Kevin Feige has offered an early indication of how Avengers: Secret Wars will shape the future of the Marvel Cinematic Universe. In comments to Entertainment Weekly, the Marvel Studios executive described the upcoming Avengers installment as a springboard for the studio's films in 2028. While attention is currently focused on Avengers: Doomsday, his remarks suggest that its successor will have significance beyond resolving the immediate storyline.

Secret Wars is scheduled for 2027, and Feige has identified the following year as the beginning of a substantially new era. The timing is particularly meaningful because 2028 marks twenty years since Iron Man launched the Marvel Cinematic Universe in 2008. The available interview excerpt does not, however, establish a complete slate of films or confirm which characters will lead that era.

Feige also encouraged audiences to look at Marvel's comic books for clues. Several comic events have carried the Secret Wars name, and one especially relevant example is the 2015 storyline written by Jonathan Hickman. That event explores the consequences of colliding universes and introduces a reconstructed setting known as Battleworld.

Doctor Doom occupies a central position in that comic storyline, which dramatically alters the structure of Marvel's fictional universe. Nevertheless, references to the comics should not be interpreted as confirmation that the cinematic adaptation will reproduce those events exactly. Marvel Studios has repeatedly drawn inspiration from established comic narratives while modifying their characters, relationships and circumstances to suit the continuity of its films.

From an editorial perspective, the twentieth anniversary presents a natural opportunity to reconsider the franchise's direction. Multiverse storytelling creates opportunities to bring together characters from different continuities and generations, but it can also make the overall narrative more difficult to follow. One of Marvel's future challenges will be developing stories that remain accessible to newcomers without disregarding the investment of longtime viewers.

The possible introduction of new mutant teams, changes to established superhero lineups and alterations to the wider cinematic continuity are subjects of considerable fan discussion. None of those specific outcomes should be treated as confirmed by the available excerpt. Likewise, Feige's description of a new era does not establish that every existing character will be recast or that previous films will cease to matter.

For now, the most significant confirmed point is the strategic role assigned to Secret Wars. Marvel is positioning the film not merely as a destination for its current stories, but as a foundation for what comes next. The precise shape of that future remains to be revealed.
